description: Given a list of products already in the cart, recommend products that frequently bundle with the cart to complete a high-confidence bundle. This is multi-item basket analysis for cart completion. Use when the user describes a multi-item cart and asks 'what else do I need?', 'what completes this set?', 'what's missing from this bundle?', 'recommend add-ons for this cart', or similar. Different from get_recommendations: this takes MULTIPLE products and returns items that pair with the cart as a whole, not single-item pairings.

limit.description: Max suggestions to return. Default 3, max 6.

product_ids.description: List of product ids currently in the cart (numeric or GID/SKU).

name: get_bundle_for_cart
